# wiiu_rom_tool

[← Command index](README.md)

Decrypt or test-decrypt Nintendo Wii U NUS packages.

## Synopsis

```
wiiu_rom_tool [options]
```

## Description

A NUS package is a directory holding `title.tmd`, `title.tik` and the encrypted
`.app`/`.h3` content files. The tool finds every `title.tik` under the input path and
treats its directory as one package.

`-r` runs CDecrypt inside the package directory, which writes the decrypted title
(`code`, `content` and `meta` folders) alongside the encrypted files. With `-d`, the
package's `.app`, `.h3`, `.tik`, `.tmd` and `.cert` files are then deleted, leaving
only the decrypted title.

`-e` copies each package to a temporary directory and decrypts the copy there to check
that CDecrypt accepts it; the package itself is not changed.

## Options

### General

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-i, --input_path <input_path>` | A directory searched recursively for NUS packages (directories holding `title.tik`); must exist. |
| `-r, --decrypt_nus` | Decrypt each package into its own directory with CDecrypt. |
| `-e, --verify_nus` | Decrypt a temporary copy of each package to check it, leaving the package unchanged. |
| `-d, --delete_originals` | With `-r`, delete the package's `.app`, `.h3`, `.tik`, `.tmd` and `.cert` files after decrypting. |

### Common options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-v, --verbose` | Enable verbose mode. |
| `-p, --pretend_run` | Do a pretend run with no permanent changes. |
| `-x, --exit_on_failure` | Enable exit on failure mode. |
| `--no-preview` | Skip the preview confirmation prompt. |

## Examples

### Test that every package in a folder decrypts

```bash
wiiu_rom_tool -i /path/to/wiiu -e
```

### Decrypt every package in place

```bash
wiiu_rom_tool -i /path/to/wiiu -r
```

### Decrypt and remove the encrypted files, previewing first

```bash
wiiu_rom_tool -i /path/to/wiiu -r -d -p -v
```

## Notes

- Without `-r` or `-e` nothing is done. If both are given, `-r` wins.
- `-e` copies the whole package, so the temporary directory needs room for it plus the decrypted output.
- CDecrypt must be installed as a JoyBox tool.
